name: As Though Beholding Illusions
description: Strange phenomena have suddenly appeared near the venue for the Mikawa Flower Festival. Dark undercurrents seem to be forming...

steps.description: Invite Ei to the Aisa Bathhouse
Talk to Ei in the Aisa Bathhouse
Go to the area outside the Aisa Bathhouse
Return to the venue on Mt. Yougou
Talk to Kinkaku and the others
Talk to Miko and the others
Go to the area outside the venue

dialogs.content: As I said, let's wait until midnight. You can attend to other matters in the meantime.
Huh... Doesn't look like Miko is around here anywhere. Paimon doesn't see Ayato or Ayaka, either...
Are we too early? Hmm... Didn't Ayato say he prepared lodging for everyone at the shrine?
...Did you hear? Someone encountered a doppelganger here last night!
A doppelganger!? You mean... like a doppelganger of themselves, or someone they know?
You know what they say... Anyone who sees their doppelganger will be replaced by them within three days..
Th—That's just a folk tale! It's not real!
#...Doppelgangers? That's a common folk tale in Inazuma, isn't it... Ever heard of it, {NICKNAME}?
I know the gist.
Yeah, it's a pretty famous one, huh... A friend being replaced by a complete stranger!
Also, the timing is a bit too coincidental, don't you think? Could it be related to what we saw last night?
The whole doppelganger thing sounds kind of like what Sayu was talking about with Bunshin Phantasm... Maybe something went wrong with Kichiboushi's powers?
Well... Thinking about it isn't going to get us anywhere. Why don't we go check on Sayu's team?
Huh... They're not here yet.
Maybe they're still asleep?
Well, if it's Sayu we're talking about, that's definitely possible... Oh, someone's coming!
Weird... Is he here to work on the equipment? But, he doesn't look like any of the workers we saw yesterday... And, it doesn't seem like he's here for the games...
Ah... He snuck away again! Do you think he might be...?
Let's follow him and see what he does.
No, never.
Huh? It always comes up in light novels... You've really never seen it? It's like when your friend is replaced by a complete stranger!
Hey, Thoma! We were hoping to learn a bit more about the philosophy behind your game. Is now a good time?
Ah, looks like our judges are hard at work this morning.
...Feel a soft bee?
Oh, um... Boss can explain that one.
Boss and Shousei were up super late last night coming up with ideas!
And, he's back at it this morning, as energetic as ever! Boss is the best!
Oh, I don't deserve that much praise... But, when it comes to the "talking" part, I guess I'm the best person to answer your questions.
Hehe... Time for an interview!
Into you...?
Ask away, judges!
What do you think is the most interesting aspect of your game?
Oh, I'd have to say... working with others to overcome challenges...
#Hold on! You can't ask such a simple question, {NICKNAME}! Watch and learn...
*ahem*... We'd love to learn more about your design approach and strategic vision. What will be the project's main draw, and how will it deliver emotional value to your players?
(That's basically the same question...)
Sounds like you took that question straight from one of those business experts in Ritou... In that case, let me say this...
This product will be a fast-paced, easy-to-digest release that capitalizes on the enduring popularity of a traditional genre while addressing its common pain points...

By reviewing our strengths and the needs of our players, we were able to synchronize them across production levels and provide a refined experience that is more receptive to our users and more enjoyable overall...
...Impressive! And... completely over Paimon's head!
(You set yourself up for that one, Paimon!)
Nice one, Boss!
Haha... I kind of confused myself, honestly. I'm used to hearing that kind of talk in Ritou, so I guess I picked up a few things.
#A fixer is a tough nut to crack, huh... Shoot, Paimon can't pick apart an answer she doesn't understand! Over to you, {NICKNAME}!
You continue asking questions, and Thoma answers faultlessly...
...So, there you have it. I hope that answered your question, judges.
Whoa... Not a single stumper...
Impressive!
Haha, well, I'm sure the interview is only one part of the evaluation process. We'll see what you think when you play the game yourself.
Which reminds me, I should probably get back to work on this stage. Wanna give it a try when we're done?
It would be my pleasure.
In that case, let's get to it!
Y—Yes, Boss Thoma!
Well... Thoma's answers were all very genuine. Paimon didn't notice anything un-Thomalike about them.
Plus, he was with Shousei until late last night... If you think about when we saw the nightmare creature, the timing doesn't match up...
Kozou and his two friends were together the whole time, too. They would have noticed if someone was acting weird.
...So, we're back at square one! *sigh*... That just leaves Kokomi's team, right? Guess we should check them out...
Never underestimate a housekeeper!
Did you design this game with anyone in mind?
Well... From a design standpoint, we want it to be a game for everyone...
Not so fast! "Everyone" isn't an answer! You need to be more specific about your target audience!
Ah... You're absolutely right. Then, allow me to revise my answer. Our target audience includes growing children, ages zero to eighteen.
Makes sense! Kids need a little exercise here and there!
Second would be active adults, ages eighteen to forty.
Right! Adults have more stamina, so they can get more out of the game.
Next would be older adults, ages forty to sixty, especially those in need of exercise.
Older adults... Hm, exercise is important for healthy aging, but something feels off about this...
Finally, we have elderly people who are still full of life. That would be the sixty to a thousand age range.
Ah, okay... Wait! That includes everyone!
Haha, well, we can't forget about the youkai, right? This game is for humans and youkai alike, after all.
But, not for Ioroi!
(Because he's trapped in a statue, I'm guessing...?)
Besides, you seemed to agree with each group, Paimon... Unless you intend to change your tune?
*ahem*... N—Next question!
*yawn*... So tired... I don't feel rested at all. How come you two have so much energy? Didn't you stay up even later than me...?
Haha, weak!
Kichiboushi! That's not a nice thing to say to a friend. Sayu's probably just tired because she came up with all the ideas yesterday!
Need a break, Sayu? I can start thinking about the ending stages in the meantime!
It's been forever since we've done something fun together! You need to have enough energy to enjoy it!
Oh, uh... I—It's okay... I can push through...
Sayu and Yoimiya seem the same as ever! Kichiboushi, too. How should we test them...?
Let's ask about the past...
Oh, good idea! Doppelgangers only mimic appearances — they wouldn't know about someone's past! Let's give it a try!
Mm! White Fur! Yellow Fur!
Whoa, you guys are here bright and early!
#Y—Yeah, well... {NICKNAME}'s judging this thing, so we can't slack off... right?
Still... You don't need to make anything, so what's the rush?
Yeah... If the people in charge are here early, that usually means there's been some kind of emergency...
#Oh, no... It's just... {NICKNAME} really wanted to see you!
(Seriously, Paimon...?)
Oh, um... Why?
Um... Well... It's... your game! Playing your game yesterday brought up a whole bunch of old memories!
So, we wanted to come early to reminisce about old times, hehe. Y'know, because you might be busy... later... and stuff...
(What kind of an excuse is that? They're busy now!)
White Fur... Acting super strange!
(Time to change the topic!)
Oh, I was just thinking about the Aranara...
Oh, you know what? Me too! I thought about adding them to our game, considering the "dream" theme and everything.
But, in the end, the ideas just wouldn't come together...
Marinara... Yum!
No, it's not a food! The Aranara are like, um... small youkai from Sumeru. They're super friendly and cute, and can give you good dreams...
Actually, that describes you, too, Kichiboushi. If you ever go to Sumeru, I'm sure you'll be considered a "good Nara"!
...Good banana?
Sumeru, huh... The dreams there are supposed to be special. Did you witness a dream or something? Maybe it could give us some inspiration, and we wouldn't have to think so much...
#Haha... Sorry, that dream is a little... hard to describe, don't you think, {NICKNAME}?
Sometimes, when there are too many feelings in a dream...
It's really hard to use as reference material.
Alright... *sigh* I was just wondering what kind of dream it was, that's all...
I guess it was the kind where... a lot of things happened! Anyway, it's a long story. How about we wait until after the competition?
#...{NICKNAME} and I can tell it together.
Sounds good.
After that, you share many more memories together...
Oh, shoot, where did the time go... We have so many levels to design today!
Oh, we should get out of your fur— hair, then! Good luck, everyone!
Bye, White Fur! Bye, Yellow Fur! Come back and play!
Wow, we've had so many adventures, huh... You don't even realize it until someone brings up the past.
Do you still remember the original meaning of our journey?
Oh, yeah, totally! It was, um... What was it again?
I figured...
Anyway, Paimon didn't pick up on anything suspicious from that team... If anything, we were the weird ones, forcing conversations and stuff...
And whose fault is that?
O—Okay, so maybe it wasn't the best strategy. Leaning into the "judge" angle is probably a safer bet...
Let's ask about the creative process behind the game and confirm their identities that way... Paimon saw Thoma's team show up just now. So, we can investigate them next!
Oh, I was just reminded of a certain ambush order...
Huh? Wh—Why are you bringing that up all of a sudden?
Well, all the bake-danuki transformations...
Reminded of the time you failed that ninjutsu technique...
Uh... Well, that was my bad... I tried to turn into a barrel, but my tail was sticking out... So, you found me immediately.
B—But this time, I'm not in charge of turning into things anymore, so it should be fine! I think...
Haha, weak!
Kichiboushi, what did I say about talking that way...? Anyway, you seemed to have a good grasp on transformations yesterday, Sayu... What's the story here...
It all started with a certain mysterious order...
Th—That one shouldn't be on me! I didn't realize I was tricked until later... Did all that work, and didn't even get to nap... Really shouldn't have taken that order...
Still... we had some fun times together, right?
Umm...
Based on what happened, I guess... You could say that...
Whoa, I've never seen this look on Sayu's face... What the heck happened back then!?
Mujina, is all red!
No, I'm not! And, I'm not a Mujina!
Oh, I was just reminded of some pilgrimage training...
Mm! Had fun with Yellow Fur!
We went to soooooo many places together!
Snowy mountain! Cold! Alcor! Big!
Wow, you traveled to all those places together?
Orange Fur come with next time?
You betcha! You should come, too, Sayu! If you can find the time, of course!
Um... Would we have to walk there?
Nope! You can just sit on the boat and listen to stories. We'd be there before you knew it!
You can nap on the boat, too.
Let the waves rock you to sleep.
R—Really?
As long as Storm-Storm not mad...
Hey! It's not like Dvalin's the one behind every single gust of wind!
Huh? White Fur and Yellow Fur are here early!
You're here alone? Huh... Where are Kokomi and the others?
Don't know about great youkai, but sole lady is behind you!
Sole lady? Oh, as in "Sole of the Deep"? Okay... Wait, did you say behind us!?
You have questions for me, I presume?
K—Kokomi! A little warning next time...
...Sounds like you already know why we're here.
Yes, I heard about the Doppelganger incident. When I saw you around the venue just now, it wasn't hard to connect the dots.
As for what you want to know...
...Energy.
Energy...? Oh! The numbers you write in your diary—
...In a tree? Dry berry?
...Ahem.
Oh, uh... S—Sorry...
So... we can leave it there, right? You don't need to ask any more questions, I would imagine...
Y—Yep, all good.
As for Gyoubu Koban... He was in the shrine all night. I can't imagine he's the criminal you're searching for.
EH!? Gyoubu Koban is a criminal!?
N—No, of course not! You're in the clear!
Phew... "In the clear"... is good?
Very good.
Good!
What about Mizuki? Where did she go?
She left after receiving a message in the middle of night... Looking back on it, perhaps it's related to your own investigation.
Oh, as she left, I heard her whisper under her breath, "Ordering me around in the middle of the night. Who does she think she is...?"
(...Miko.)
(She probably needed an expert on nightmares to help formulate a strategy... Well, I guess that also confirms Mizuki's identity.)
Hm, something tells me a certain someone is missing me...
Huh? Miko! And Mizuki!
#*yawn*... Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Did you finish up your work?
Yes, I left the rest to the young fellow from the Kamisato Clan. At least for now, there's nothing suspicious to note.
That means... the culprit didn't manage to sneak in? That's a relief...
Just like that, you let down your guard? And all it took was for me to wear her face...
...EH!? Th—The culprit! I—It's you!
If you keep joking like this...
Oh? Greedy little thing... I thought we agreed on twenty?
Making a joke like that...
#*sigh* It's getting harder and harder to tease you, {NICKNAME}.
Can you stop with the teasing, then? Even I'm reaching my limit...
Five hundred years, and you're still not used to it? Sounds like you need more practice.
At least spare me for the day. I can't take the mental torment right now. I'm running on fumes...
So, what did you do last night...?
Investigated the Shogunate officials' nightmares, analyzed the traces of youkai power around Mt. Yougou... Oh, and worked on some new game stages, of course.
All in one night!?
Well, I didn't want someone to ruin the Mikawa Flower Festival... But I also wanted to do my best for my part of the Festival.
Besides, I've talked to many patients who worked multiple jobs just to make ends meet. Compared to that, complaining about one night of hard work is a little... unreasonable, don't you think?
Even so, I think you should take a break, Miss Mizuki. Gyoubu Koban and I can handle the game development in the meantime.
I learned a lot yesterday. I'm sure I can handle a few design elements while you get some rest.
We can't have our lead developer out of commission. I'm not confident I can bring our vision to fruition on my own.
You're very persuasive, Kokomi. It would seem you also have a talent for clinical psychology... I'll leave it to you two, then.
Sweet dreams!
Mizuki goes to rest. A little unsteady on her feet, she looks exhausted...
Mizuki really cares about the festival, huh... She's putting so much pressure on herself...
...Perhaps she's reminded of the festivals of the past, when I was just a kit, and Mizuki a young baku.
...We would rush past the other youkai, desperate to get the first piece of Fried Tofu from the ramen stand.
Hmph, it would seem she hasn't forgotten, even after five hundred years.
Sounds like you haven't forgotten, either...
...You know, there's something to be said for knowing when to keep your mouth shut, little one.
Hmph... Enough about the past. We must focus on the matter at hand.
But... you didn't notice anything suspicious, right? That should mean the culprit didn't sneak in...
That's one possibility. The other... is that the culprit's "transformation" is even more convincing than we imagined.
In that case, we need a "detective" with a more professional skillset... Or, we need to find a way to provoke them and get their facade to crack.
But, that sounds dangerous!
If the culprit is deep in disguise, a slight provocation won't completely expose them.
What we need is to create reasonable doubt, make the culprit question whether their cover is blown... As they hesitate over whether to make some kind of last stand, that is our chance.
So, how do you plan to provoke them?
Oh, Ei didn't tell you? Hehe... Allow me to show you.
...Ladies and gentlemen, on behalf of the Mikawa Flower Festival, it is my honor to announce...
An esteemed guest from Tenshukaku has agreed to take part in this year's festival!
Please welcome, Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder!
It... It's the Shogun!
The Almighty Shogun... is here in person?
So, this was your plan, Miko.
Well? Not bad, right?
Wow, that was quite the entrance... Paimon can't believe she agreed to that...
...The Almighty Shogun's presence is bound to cause a stir. Instead of struggling to maintain a low profile, it's better for her to step into the open.
And, it means a detective can slip into the venue alongside the retinue, without turning any heads at all.
In the presence of the Shogun, not even the most cunning of criminals can let down their guard. Their every move needs to be faultless.
The more you focus on getting one thing right, the easier it is for the rest to become cracks in the glass...
That's what Miko wants us to take advantage of...
And, she's using the Almighty Shogun as bait... Hmph, the Lady Guuji is as daring as ever.
Why didn't you clue us in earlier? We wasted all that time asking pointless questions...
Your intel was very useful, actually. We don't know how things will unfold, but I have a feeling the truth will be revealed soon.
#In the meantime, stick with the Shogun, {NICKNAME}. We need everyone focused on her.
I'll do my best...
...Alright. Under my command, the Tenryou Commission will remain on high alert. If anything goes wrong, report back to me at once.
(After that... We surveyed each stall, just like yesterday...)
(Ei's presence definitely caused a stir, but it didn't take long for the festive atmosphere to return...)
(Maybe a day will come when Ei can leave Tenshukaku, and it won't be so out of the ordinary.)
(Remain silent...)
You're the only one in Inazuma who would do that.
I want thirty percent of the profit.
...A—Almighty Shogun! Glory to your everlasting reign... I—I mean... Welcome, welcome!
This stall looks familiar. Yet, it would seem the ownership has changed hands...?
Ah... You must be thinking of Tomoki. H—He... wasn't feeling well today, so I'm filling in... haha...
I see... Yet, you remind me of someone — a Doushin from the Tenryou Commission...
Oh, uh...
What are you looking at, Ei?
Hm, the food offerings. Although, this vendor seems...
(The "vendor" is giving me a pleading look... Judging by his cooking skill, it almost seems like his first day on the job...)
Ei... He's "working."
Working...? Ah.
...I see. I appreciate your dedication, sir.
O—Of course! It's an honor to serve such esteemed guests!
No need for formalities... I'll take three orders of Dango Milk.
...Right away!
Three orders? So, Paimon gets one, too?
Yes, I wanted to thank you for accompanying me. Without you by my side, I imagine the people here would be on edge even now.
I have my reasons for being here, of course, but I would hate to tarnish the festive atmosphere.
This festival is for everyone.
Heh, indeed. The Mikawa Flower Festival... Hundreds of years have passed since I last partook in the festivities. Much is different this time — the people, the place, the games...
Yet, the name endures, and the joy of celebration along with it... I suppose that, in itself, is a form of Eternity.
#{NICKNAME}, Paimon... and the Almighty Shogun?
Oh, Mizuki! Looks like you got some much-needed rest!
Yumemizuki Mizuki... Thank you for your aid earlier.
Of course, I'm always willing to help. It's my duty... I wish I could have dispelled the nightmares, but this situation is uncharted territory for me.
Even so, relieving the pain of the nightmares is no small feat. You honor the legacy of the Yumekui-Baku.
So, not even Mizuki could fix it... What's going on with this nightmare creature...?
...Let's save the difficult questions for later. Actually, I came here to ask you something.
Wanna come to Aisa Bathhouse with me? Most of the contestants will be there... Oh, and don't worry about payment — it's my treat!
Really? Yes! Yes! Let's go!
You want us to go to the hot springs... now?
Well, game development isn't easy. Most of the contestants are exhausted and could use a break.
You've been under a lot of pressure yourselves, with the investigation and all. So, I thought you might like to join.
#Of course we would! Right, {NICKNAME}?
...I will remain here. I rarely have time away from Tenshukaku, and I would like to continue perusing the stalls.
Aw... That's too bad...
Then, I'm not going, either...
#Ah, I almost forgot! Miko wanted to talk to you, {NICKNAME}. I'll take you to her first.
Oh? Well why don't we all go—
Almighty Shogun! Your Dango Milk is ready...
Oooh... Delicious!
No need, Shogun! Miko just had some quick things to go over with the judges, that's all — you and Paimon can wait here. We'll only be a minute!
Be right back.
...Alright, now we can talk freely.
Miko doesn't need to see me, does she...
I think something's off with the Shogun. You've been with her the whole day. Have you noticed anything?
S—Something off? No...
Up close, sometimes it's hard to see the whole picture... I think something is troubling her.
(Something did seem off with Ei today... Maybe she's not used to leaving Tenshukaku? Or was it the reaction of the crowd...?)
(No, we've been through so much. Something so trivial wouldn't shake her... She must be keeping something to herself...)
I've witnessed a lot of cases where patients, for a variety of reasons, are unwilling or unable to seek help. Unfortunately, that only exacerbates the problem...
Until their emotions become so heavy, even the strongest of people collapse under the weight... I see those warning signs in the Shogun.
So, even the archons aren't immune to emotional strain?
Humans, youkai, and archons bear the same capacity for emotion and are, naturally, susceptible to the same mental turmoil.
It's very possible that someone who appears strong on the outside has learned to compartmentalize their negative emotions... And that is far from healthy.
...I understand.
#Anyway, the quickest route to curing the mind is through the heart! That's where you come in, {NICKNAME}!
As a clinical psychologist, isn't that where YOU come in?
Approaching someone in a professional capacity often makes them more guarded. But, don't worry! You'll still have my help!
Here, with these two special coupons, you can get into Aisa Bathhouse after closing. Then, this is what you're gonna do...
Finally! You're back! Paimon's had two servings of Dango Milk already!
#Sorry for the wait... It sounds like {NICKNAME} has other plans, Paimon. So, we'll have to head to the bathhouse on our own.
Huh? You're not coming...?
I'll explain later... Just have fun!
Okay... Paimon will bring you back a Hot Spring Egg!
...There is no need to stay behind on my behalf. If you leave now, I'm sure you can catch up.
Something tells me YOU chose to stay behind on OUR behalf...
...What makes you say that?
You want everyone to relax.
...If my presence makes them nervous or impedes their ability to relax, does that not defeat the purpose of going to the hot springs?
I already disturbed their progress by coming to the festival. The last thing everyone needs is more distractions.
...But, aren't you under pressure, too?
As you know, this body is hardly that fragile. It can operate for another hundred years with no issue.
...You didn't deny it.
...Hah. Mortals are weak in body and mind. If there is a choice of who to bear such a burden, naturally that person should be me.
What if you didn't have to worry about bothering anyone...
What does it matter? The world is not so easily bent to one's will...
I'll take that as a yes.
I have a pair of special coupons here...
#Heh, what clever verbal tricks, {NICKNAME}... It appears you've been spending too much time with Miko.
It's an honest offer...
You think you can get away with manipulating the Shogun? I wouldn't be so sure...
...C'mon, let's go!
*sigh* Persistent indeed... Very well. As you proposed, we shall set out at midnight.
You'll go, won't you?
We can get into the bathhouse after closing.
Would you agree to go to the hot springs then?
You don't want people to be on edge because of you.
Yeah, she seems troubled...
Exactly! You noticed, too...
You needed to talk to me in private. Why?
Okay, I'll go...
Including you.
Well, shall we head out?
...Steam replete with the scent of orchids. Water that turns the complexion a blushing pink... So, this is a hot spring.
Is it your first time here?
Yes, there are Royal Hot Springs near Tenshukaku. But, the plans were set in motion only after Hiiragi Hiroshi introduced the Snezhnayan Blast Furnace to Inazuma, and that was five hundred years ago.
When the project was complete, I was already in the Plane of Euthymia... And, naturally, the body of the Shogun has no need for such luxuries.
Hiiragi Hiroshi...
The members of the Kanjou Commission were once friends with Makoto and the Kitsune Saiguu. Although mere mortals, those who managed to survived back then were special individuals indeed.
What happened back then?
...What makes you say that?
The look on your face...
...Now I see why my officials claim that the hot springs facilitate conversation. Even I find myself divulging more than intended.
...You're correct. Following the dark disaster five hundred years ago, a Nightmare engulfed Inazuma.

On a battlefield consumed in darkness, our soldiers fought against dark forces, creatures capable of possessing people and trapping them in nightmares. Even the Yumekui-Baku could do nothing to wake them.
As awful as that sounds...
...Perhaps not. The battle was intense. Those who stood up in defense of this land knew the chance of survival was slim. In the face of certain death, surely a nightmare is nothing to fear...
But, what if I told you this... If the person trapped in the nightmare was strong enough to overcome incapacitation, it would become a waking nightmare instead.
The person would lose all capacity to distinguish dream from reality, perceiving everything in the real world as a continuation of the war.
And every precious thing in life as an enemy to be annihilated... That is a far more painful nightmare, both for the person in question and those around them.
(...If I hadn't broken out of the nightmare yesterday, would that have happened to me? Then, Ei must be so worried because...)
Did that happen to someone... back then?
...Yes.
And...?
I... unleashed Musou no Hitotachi and struck her down.
No need. I have no regrets. I know it was the right decision, both for Inazuma's sake and her own.
If necessary, I would do it again.
Ei...
...Well, it's about time you two showed yourselves, yes? You've listened in long enough.
Heh.
Oh? It's you two.
...Before you say anything, this part wasn't me.
Well, since the cat's out of the bag...
How about a hot spring tea party?
Hey!
Ahhh... Nice and warm. No wonder the hot springs relaxed your inhibitions, Ei...
...So, who came up with this idea? I want the truth.
I guess... both of us?
Well, I happened to consult a certain clinical psychologist about how to get an old friend to open up...
In her expert opinion, doing something new with a trusted companion in a new environment can make someone less guarded... Looks like it worked like a charm.
I understand the reasoning...
It's one thing to trust that Miko has good intentions, but would you let your guard down around her?
...Good point.
Hehe...
...Your concern is misplaced. I kept these matters to myself because I was unsure whether this incident is connected to the past, and I did not want to interfere with the investigation.
If the investigation reached an impasse or new clues pointed to the Nightmare from back then... Naturally, I would have discussed this intel with you.
Intel, huh... It appears you still don't understand why I wanted you to open up in the first place.
Help! Help me!
What was that!?
(Then, Ei must be so worried because...)
Sounds like it came from outside. Let's check it out!
But, why not do it yourself?
...I'm sorry.
What happened...?
It doesn't seem bad enough to make you this upset.
Does it have anything to do with what's happening right now?
Oh, no... Someone's unconscious!
Uh... Ugh...
Is it the Nightmare!?
It seems different in some respects... Step back and allow me to examine her.
Ugh... Ah!
...She's awake?
What's going on... Ah! A—Almighty Shogun!
What happened just now? What frightened you?
Sh—Shogun... I... I...
It's alright. With the Shogun here, nothing can hurt you. Just take a deep breath and tell us what happened.
Phew... I almost fainted again just now...
Is that what happened earlier? You fainted?
Yes... I was on my way to Uyuu Restaurant, and as I was crossing the bridge, I saw someone staring at me from behind a tree!
It was hard to make out their appearance in the dark, but I had a bad feeling... So, I tried to get a closer look in the moonlight...
And, it was... It was me!
In that moment, I thought about how people who see their doppelganger usually end up dead, and I fainted from the shock... I don't remember anything after that...
A doppelganger? In Inazuma City? But, we only detected traces of the Nightmare around Mt. Yougou...
I heard that people encountered doppelgangers on Mt. Yougou, too! C—Could it be the work of some terrible youkai?
Don't worry about that...
